patterns.note: Sections reveal with a subtle fade-up and slide-up animation as they scroll into view, creating a dynamic content progression.
The hero section's background gradient and graphic elements exhibit a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground text.
A vibrant, multi-stop orange gradient is used as a full-bleed background for the hero and a prominent call-to-action section, serving as a key brand identifier.
Consistent use of a clean, single-column layout with generous vertical spacing between distinct content blocks, enhancing readability.
Uppercase, smaller labels are used for section titles and subheadings, providing clear categorization and contrasting with larger, bold primary headings.

technique_notes: Uses GSAP ScrollTrigger to orchestrate staggered fade-up and slight slide-up animations for content sections as they enter the viewport, creating a smooth and engaging reveal effect.
The navigation bar transitions to a fixed position at the top of the viewport after the user scrolls past the initial hero section, maintaining its original visual style.
Full-bleed gradient backgrounds are employed in key sections (hero, footer CTA) to establish brand identity and visual hierarchy, using a soft, multi-stop orange blend.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) create strong hierarchy, complemented by smaller uppercase labels and readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and cards, maintaining a clean yet approachable aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and balanced spacing within card grids.

standout: The distinctive use of a vibrant, soft orange gradient as a primary brand element, especially in the full-bleed hero and repeated in the footer CTA, sets a warm and energetic tone. Combined with the clean, minimal layout and subtle scroll animations, it feels modern and inviting without being overly complex. The playful orange fruit graphic in the hero adds a unique touch.
